carried_forward_from_phase_35.pdh_pdl: Prior same-contract RTH 09:30-16:00 high/low from completed 1m bars.
carried_forward_from_phase_35.sweep_up: first RTH 1m bar with high > PDH
carried_forward_from_phase_35.sweep_down: first RTH 1m bar with low < PDL
carried_forward_from_phase_35.penetration: PDH: bar.high - PDH; PDL: PDL - bar.low
carried_forward_from_phase_35.news: Eligible sample excludes full CPI/NFP publication dates. Strict ±5m around 08:30 never overlaps RTH.
carried_forward_from_phase_35.roll: volume-crossover, 18:00 NY activation; PDH/PDL on the same raw contract as the sweep RTH day
carried_forward_from_phase_35.eligible_universe: phase35_sweep_events.csv (269 news-filtered events). Not re-detected with new rules.

shallow.not_used: Phase 34 sample median 26.375; Phase 36 outcome-maximizing cutoffs

first_sweep.primary: earliest eligible sweep on that RTH day (PDH or PDL). Keep only if that first sweep is also shallow.

reclaim.A_range_1m: After confirmation, first completed 1m bar whose range crosses back through the level. Sweep-bar wick-only reclaim (close still beyond the level) is NOT taken — same-bar sweep vs reclaim order is unknown on 1m.
reclaim.B_close_1m: First completed 1m bar at or after confirmation whose close is back through the level.
reclaim.C_close_5m: Diagnostic. First 5m bar (RTH-aligned from 09:30) that closes through the level after confirmation.

entry.timing: next 1m bar OPEN after the confirming bar close
entry.direction: PDL sweep -> LONG; PDH sweep -> SHORT

targets.flatten: 15:55 America/New_York TIME_EXIT if neither stop nor target hit
targets.same_bar_stop_and_target: AMBIGUOUS — do not assume target first

expiry.clock: from sweep confirmation (bar close), not bar open

costs.primary_fill: 1 tick adverse entry, 0 extra exit ticks (stop/target are stop orders)

primary_candidate.name: SHALLOW_FIRST_SWEEP + 1M_CLOSE_RECLAIM
primary_candidate.reason: 1m close is leak-safe confirmation. 1.5R is the middle of the target family, not the maximum. 1-tick fill is the realistic primary overlay. Chosen before seeing Phase 36 trade results.

dom: NOT IN THE LIVE FEATURE SET. No MBP, MBO, CVD, imbalance, FVG, CHoCH, RSI, MA.
note: Shallow threshold was not searched against Phase 36 P&L.
